_doc: OPS-PLANS-PUBLIC-ENTERPRISE-DEPRICE-W1 CH1 R1.1 — the PRE-FIX served body, captured verbatim.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. GET /api/plans/public is unauthenticated, listed in .well-known/api-catalog
and deliberately fed to AI crawlers. It published price_usd: 299 on the enterprise rung while
brand-facts.md:552 lists "$299/mo as an Enterprise list price" as a HIGH-severity forbidden phrase
and :143 states Enterprise no longer publishes a price. Every human surface already refused it;
this endpoint — the machine-readable one, the one fed to LLMs — did not.
THREE controls missed it, each differently. check-forbidden-phrases.mjs globs FILES, and a served
HTTP response is in no glob and cannot be. The frozen shape snapshot bans key NAMES only — it has
no forbidden-VALUE concept at all — and it captured 299 as APPROVED. And that snapshot carries a
drift_check_command which is a shell string in a JSON field that nothing has ever executed.
This body is CH2 proof fixture: --prove-catches-ch1 runs the offline rules against it and must
report FAIL. A gate never observed catching the defect it was built for is not evidence.
CACHE DISCIPLINE (R1.5): the endpoint serves cache-control: public, max-age=300, so this read used
a unique cache-buster query parameter. An un-busted read can return a body up to five minutes old
and read as either a failure or a success.
DO NOT correct the 299 below. It is the record of what was served.
cache_buster: unique query parameter, per CH1 R1.5
